privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.meta: How CELESTIA collects, uses and protects your personal data.

sections.p: CELESTIA operates this online store. This policy explains what personal data we collect when you browse, create an account, subscribe or place an order, and how we use it.

Contact details (name, email, phone), delivery addresses, order history, your language preference and, if you subscribe, your newsletter consent. We do not collect or store payment card numbers or security codes — any online payment is handled by the payment provider.
To process and deliver orders, provide customer care, keep your account secure, and — only with your consent — send newsletters. We do not sell personal data.
We use a strictly necessary session cookie to keep you signed in, a cookie to remember your language, and your browser’s local storage to keep your bag and guest wishlist.
You can view and update your details in your account, unsubscribe from emails at any time, and ask us to export or delete your data by contacting client care.
We keep order records for as long as required by law and protect accounts with hashed passwords and secure, http-only session cookies.

terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.meta: Terms that apply to purchases from CELESTIA.

sections.p: An order is a request to purchase. We confirm it by phone or email once stock and delivery details are verified. We may decline orders, for example if an item is unavailable.
Prices are shown in Uzbek soʻm and include applicable taxes. Delivery charges are shown before you place your order.
Available payment methods are shown at checkout. Cash on delivery is paid to the courier on receipt. Online payment methods are offered only once they have been fully integrated and tested.
Delivery timings are estimates. Risk passes to you on delivery. Please inspect your parcel on receipt.
Unworn items with original tags may be returned within 14 days of delivery, in line with our shipping & returns policy and applicable consumer law.
Nothing in these terms limits your statutory rights as a consumer.

legalDraft: This document is a template for the demonstration store and must be reviewed by a legal professional before launch.
